title: The lie about Lara Croft's father in Rise of the Tomb Raider
subject: lara
description:
Who do you think gave the order? 👇

What Lara Croft learned about her father's death in Rise of the Tomb Raider. Spoilers for Rise of the Tomb Raider.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Crystal Dynamics, Eidos-Montréal or Square Enix. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Everyone told Lara that her father had killed himself.
Lord Richard Croft chased the Divine Source, a relic said to grant immortality, until the press laughed him out of his field.
After his wife Amelia died, a woman named Ana came into his life.
In Siberia, in 2015, Lara learned Ana worked for Trinity, the order hunting that relic, and had loved him only to spy on him.
After the credits, Lara confronted her. Ana denied any part in it, but admitted it was no suicide.
A Trinity sniper shot her before she could say who gave the order.
